# MUNIS USMAN

> A Tashkent-based wearable-art brand. Hand-embroidered accessories, illustrations, and made-to-order objects since 2014.

MUNIS USMAN creates limited-edition pieces and bespoke commissions that combine modern design with Uzbek craft tradition (suzani, ikat, miniature). Every item is made in small batches in our Tashkent studio.
